dialogues.jp: 約束の時間の５分前。
dialogues.en: 5 minutes before the scheduled time.
dialogues.text: 5 minutes before the scheduled time.

dialogues.jp:
珍しく俺は、時間通りに待ち合わせに向かって
いた。
dialogues.en:
Unlike the norm, I headed to the meeting place a little
early.
dialogues.text:
Unlike the norm, I headed to the meeting place a little
early.

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、妄想が効いてるのかな。
dialogues.en: Hope I've managed to kill off those wild ideas...
dialogues.text: Hope I've managed to kill off those wild ideas...

dialogues.jp:
待ち合わせの喫茶店の前に行くと、もう環が待っ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
I reached the front of the coffeeshop we were supposed to
meet at. Tamaki was already there.
dialogues.text:
I reached the front of the coffeeshop we were supposed to
meet at. Tamaki was already there.

dialogues.jp: 「悪い悪い」
dialogues.en: "Oh, damn."
dialogues.text: "Oh, damn."

dialogues.jp: 俺は少し駆け足で、環に歩み寄る。
dialogues.en: I sped up my walk towards Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I sped up my walk towards Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
こんな時にも、巫女装束を着てくるなんて、ホ
ント徹底してるっていうか、らしいっていうか。
dialogues.en:
Even at this kind of time and occasion, she was still
wearing her Miko outfit.
dialogues.text:
Even at this kind of time and occasion, she was still
wearing her Miko outfit.

dialogues.jp: 「ごめん、待たせたかな？」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, did I make you wait?"
dialogues.text: "Sorry, did I make you wait?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いいえ。今来たところです」
dialogues.en: "No, I'd just arrived."
dialogues.text: "No, I'd just arrived."

dialogues.jp: 環はニッコリ微笑む。
dialogues.en: She smiled gently.
dialogues.text: She smiled gently.

dialogues.jp:
お約束だな。と、思いながらも、そう言っても
らえるとやっぱり安心する。
dialogues.en:
We promised this time after all... but I'm glad I didn't
stand her up.
dialogues.text:
We promised this time after all... but I'm glad I didn't
stand her up.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様も早いですね。多分、遅れてくるかと
　思っていたのですが……」
dialogues.en:
"You're early as well, Asakura-sama. I thought you might be
a little late..."
dialogues.text:
"You're early as well, Asakura-sama. I thought you might be
a little late..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「環、人間観察鋭いな」
dialogues.en: "You're a pretty good judge of people."
dialogues.text: "You're a pretty good judge of people."

dialogues.jp:
やっぱり俺って、そんな風に思われるキャラな
んだよな。
dialogues.en: She thinks of me that way, huh...
dialogues.text: She thinks of me that way, huh...

dialogues.jp: もちろん、実際その通りなんだけど。
dialogues.en: Of course, I can't say it isn't true.
dialogues.text: Of course, I can't say it isn't true.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「水越さんとかがそう噂してましたから」
dialogues.en: "That is what I heard from Mizukoshi-san, anyway."
dialogues.text: "That is what I heard from Mizukoshi-san, anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「眞子のやつめ……」
dialogues.en: "...That Mako..."
dialogues.text: "...That Mako..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「でも、時間通りに来てくれて嬉しいです」
dialogues.en: "But, I'm glad you made it early today."
dialogues.text: "But, I'm glad you made it early today."

dialogues.jp:
微笑みながらの環の言葉に、俺のほうまでなん
か嬉しくなってくる。
dialogues.en: Seeing her joyful smile made me that much happier as well.
dialogues.text: Seeing her joyful smile made me that much happier as well.

dialogues.jp: ……俺、環のことを意識してるのかな？
dialogues.en: ...Am I starting to get those... senses, again?
dialogues.text: ...Am I starting to get those... senses, again?

dialogues.jp: 昨日の妄想とは違って、もっと別の形で……。
dialogues.en: This is unlike yesterday though, it's... different somehow.
dialogues.text: This is unlike yesterday though, it's... different somehow.

dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、行こうか」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, let's move."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, let's move."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: 俺達は歩きはじめる。
dialogues.en: We started walking.
dialogues.text: We started walking.

dialogues.jp:
デートらしいデートなんて、ほとんどしたこと
ないせいか、互いにぎこちなく歩く。
dialogues.en:
Unlike most dates, we didn't have anything planned, so we
ended up walking around somewhat awkwardly.
dialogues.text:
Unlike most dates, we didn't have anything planned, so we
ended up walking around somewhat awkwardly.

dialogues.jp: しばらく、沈黙が続いた後、環が口を開く。
dialogues.en: Tamaki eventually broke the bout of silence.
dialogues.text: Tamaki eventually broke the bout of silence.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「あの、でもデートって、具体的に何をするん
　ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Um... what do people do on dates?"
dialogues.text: "Um... what do people do on dates?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「その……よくわからないんです」
dialogues.en: "I... don't really know anything about that."
dialogues.text: "I... don't really know anything about that."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ひょっとして、デートの意味も分からず、俺
　を誘ったの？」
dialogues.en:
"You asked me out on a date without even knowing what it
meant?"
dialogues.text:
"You asked me out on a date without even knowing what it
meant?"

dialogues.jp: 環は恥ずかしそうに、コクリと頷く。
dialogues.en: She embarassedly nodded.
dialogues.text: She embarassedly nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「デートって言葉はよく耳にするのですが、実
　際どうしてるのかは知らないんです」
dialogues.en:
"I have heard a lot about it, but experiencing it is a
different matter..."
dialogues.text:
"I have heard a lot about it, but experiencing it is a
different matter..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんだ……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.jp: 参ったな。
dialogues.en: Well, that's revealing.
dialogues.text: Well, that's revealing.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、俺も初めてのデートだから、似たような
ものだけど……。
dialogues.en: It's my first date as well though, so I can't say much...
dialogues.text: It's my first date as well though, so I can't say much...

dialogues.jp: 「うーん。環、どこか行きたいところある？」
dialogues.en: "Well... Tamaki, do you have any place you want to go to?"
dialogues.text: "Well... Tamaki, do you have any place you want to go to?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね……」
dialogues.en: "Well..."
dialogues.text: "Well..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、活動写真を……」
dialogues.en: "There are the films..."
dialogues.text: "There are the films..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それって、映画のことか？」
dialogues.en: "You mean, a movie?"
dialogues.text: "You mean, a movie?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。是非、見てみたいです！」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I want to watch one!"
dialogues.text: "Yes. I want to watch one!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「まだ、映画館に行ったことが無いんですよ」
dialogues.en: "I have not been to a movie theater before."
dialogues.text: "I have not been to a movie theater before."

dialogues.jp:
デートの初心者というか、いまどき映画を見に
行ったことすらないとは……。
dialogues.en:
Being a beginner at dating, fine, but not ever having
watched a movie at a theather?
dialogues.text:
Being a beginner at dating, fine, but not ever having
watched a movie at a theather?

dialogues.jp:
巫女って、そんな人種なのかな？　それとも環
が特殊なんだろうか？
dialogues.en:
Is that common to all Miko? Or does Tamaki just happen to be
special?
dialogues.text:
Is that common to all Miko? Or does Tamaki just happen to be
special?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あの……それって、変ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Um... did I say something weird?"
dialogues.text: "Um... did I say something weird?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いや、それで決まりにしよう」
dialogues.en: "Nah... then it's decided."
dialogues.text: "Nah... then it's decided."

dialogues.jp:
俺は腕時計を見る。映画の上映時間にしては中
途半端な時刻だ。
dialogues.en:
I checked my wristwatch... the theater would be right in the
middle of a movie right now.
dialogues.text:
I checked my wristwatch... the theater would be right in the
middle of a movie right now.

dialogues.jp: 「でも、上映まで時間があるな」
dialogues.en: "We have some time before the next screening, though."
dialogues.text: "We have some time before the next screening, though."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「喫茶店にでも入って、時間潰すか」
dialogues.en: "Let's pass some time in the coffeeshop."
dialogues.text: "Let's pass some time in the coffeeshop."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。ついていきます」
dialogues.en: "Okay, I'd follow you."
dialogues.text: "Okay, I'd follow you."

dialogues.jp:
喫茶店というより、茶屋だな。俺は風見学園学
生御用達『花より団子』にやってきた。
dialogues.en:
I led Tamaki to Kazami Academy students' favourite hangout,
Hana Yori Dango.
dialogues.text:
I led Tamaki to Kazami Academy students' favourite hangout,
Hana Yori Dango.

dialogues.jp:
環は、こういう茶屋にもやってきたことがない
のか、キョロキョロと辺りを見渡している。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki hadn't been to a place like this before either, and
was constantly glancing all over the place.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki hadn't been to a place like this before either, and
was constantly glancing all over the place.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「わたくし、初めて入りました。あれはいった
　い何ですか？」
dialogues.en: "What is that object? I've not seen it before..."
dialogues.text: "What is that object? I've not seen it before..."

dialogues.jp:
環が指差したのは、カウンターにあるコーヒー
メーカーだった。
dialogues.en: Tamaki pointed at a coffee-maker sitting on the counter.
dialogues.text: Tamaki pointed at a coffee-maker sitting on the counter.

dialogues.jp:
ここは、いつからコーヒーも置くようになった
のか。
dialogues.en: When did they start serving coffee here too, I wonder.
dialogues.text: When did they start serving coffee here too, I wonder.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　コーヒーをつくる機械だよ」
dialogues.en: "That? It's a machine that makes coffee."
dialogues.text: "That? It's a machine that makes coffee."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ここは、かの有名なコーヒーが飲めるところ
　なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "You can drink that famous coffee here?"
dialogues.text: "You can drink that famous coffee here?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「かの有名……かどうかは知らないけれど、コー
　ヒーも飲めるみたいだな」
dialogues.en: "...I wouldn't say famous, but yeah, looks like you can."
dialogues.text: "...I wouldn't say famous, but yeah, looks like you can."

dialogues.jp:
環のえらくワクワクした顔を見ていると、少々
たじろいでしまいそうだが、あまり追及はしな
いでおこう。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki was still staring at the machine, like it was a
magical object.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki was still staring at the machine, like it was a
magical object.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、コーヒーにする？」
dialogues.en: "I guess you'd want coffee?"
dialogues.text: "I guess you'd want coffee?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。はい！」
dialogues.en: "Yes, yes!"
dialogues.text: "Yes, yes!"

dialogues.jp:
環は嬉しそうに何度も頷く。新鮮だなぁ……こ
ういう反応って。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki nodded her head numerous times. She really is new at
this, to have a reaction like that...
dialogues.text:
Tamaki nodded her head numerous times. She really is new at
this, to have a reaction like that...

dialogues.jp: コーヒーを二つ頼むと、すぐに運ばれてきた。
dialogues.en: I ordered two coffees, which were quickly served to us.
dialogues.text: I ordered two coffees, which were quickly served to us.

dialogues.jp:
なにやら、湯飲みのようなカップに入ってやっ
てきた。なんだか、新鮮な気分だ。
dialogues.en:
They served it in traditional teacups though... it's quite
interesting.
dialogues.text:
They served it in traditional teacups though... it's quite
interesting.

dialogues.jp: ｛・・・・／コーヒー｝じゃなくて｛・・／珈琲｝ってところか。
dialogues.en: It's not simply coffee, but cappucino!
dialogues.text: It's not simply coffee, but cappucino!

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「この黒い汁がコーヒーなのですね」
dialogues.en: "This black drink is coffee..."
dialogues.text: "This black drink is coffee..."

dialogues.jp: 環は、珍しそうにカップを覗き込んでいる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki peered at the cup in front of her.
dialogues.text: Tamaki peered at the cup in front of her.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Yep."
dialogues.text: "Yep."

dialogues.jp: 俺はそのままコーヒーを飲む。
dialogues.en: I started on my own cup.
dialogues.text: I started on my own cup.

dialogues.jp: 環も真似をして、カップに口をつける。
dialogues.en: Mimicking me, Tamaki brought her cup to her mouth.
dialogues.text: Mimicking me, Tamaki brought her cup to her mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「うわ、苦〜い」
dialogues.en: "Wah, it's bitter!"
dialogues.text: "Wah, it's bitter!"

dialogues.jp:
環は一口飲み、渋い顔をする。そんな仕草のひ
とつひとつが可愛かった。
dialogues.en:
She wrinkled her face at the one taste. Those little actions
and behaviours just enhance her cuteness...
dialogues.text:
She wrinkled her face at the one taste. Those little actions
and behaviours just enhance her cuteness...

dialogues.jp: 「苦かったら、そこの砂糖をいれるといい」
dialogues.en: "If it's too bitter, try to put some sugar inside."
dialogues.text: "If it's too bitter, try to put some sugar inside."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環のカップに砂糖を入れてやる。
dialogues.en: I poured a bit of sugar into her cup of coffee.
dialogues.text: I poured a bit of sugar into her cup of coffee.

dialogues.jp:
すごく自分が優しくなってる気がする。どちら
かというと、お父さんの心境だろうか。
dialogues.en:
I did it with more gentleness than I usually have... like I
was a father.
dialogues.text:
I did it with more gentleness than I usually have... like I
was a father.

dialogues.jp:
初めて町に連れ出した娘が、色々な初めてに驚
く様子を楽しんでいる気分だった。
dialogues.en:
Taking his daughter out for the first time, showing and
protecting her from new things...
dialogues.text:
Taking his daughter out for the first time, showing and
protecting her from new things...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「あ、ちょっと甘くなりました。朝倉様、あり
　がとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Ah, it's a little sweeter now. Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Ah, it's a little sweeter now. Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どういたしまして」
dialogues.en: "You're welcome."
dialogues.text: "You're welcome."

dialogues.jp: 初々しくて、可愛いよな。
dialogues.en: Her sheer innocence... too cute.
dialogues.text: Her sheer innocence... too cute.

dialogues.jp:
今時、コーヒーを知らない女の子なんて、そう
はいないだろう。
dialogues.en:
It's nearly impossible to find a girl who's not known of
coffee nowadays.
dialogues.text:
It's nearly impossible to find a girl who's not known of
coffee nowadays.

dialogues.jp: ある意味、貴重かもしれない。
dialogues.en: That kind of rarity, it's almost precious.
dialogues.text: That kind of rarity, it's almost precious.

dialogues.jp: 環はコーヒーを全部飲み干すと、
dialogues.en: Eventually, Tamaki had finished her cup.
dialogues.text: Eventually, Tamaki had finished her cup.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「なんか、目が冴えてきました。頑張れそうな
　気がします！」
dialogues.en: "My eyes seem so wide open... I feel a lot more energetic!"
dialogues.text: "My eyes seem so wide open... I feel a lot more energetic!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そのような飲み物だと、本で読みました」
dialogues.en: "I've heard of drinks like that from books."
dialogues.text: "I've heard of drinks like that from books."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「……いや、まあ、確かにそうなんだけどね。
　ほとんどは、気分の問題だよ」
dialogues.en:
"...No, well... that is true, but it depends on your mood
too."
dialogues.text:
"...No, well... that is true, but it depends on your mood
too."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "O, oh, really?"
dialogues.text: "O, oh, really?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「まぁね」
dialogues.en: "Pretty much."
dialogues.text: "Pretty much."

dialogues.jp:
言いながら、恥ずかしさと驚きの入り混じった
環の顔から視線を腕時計へと移す。
dialogues.en:
I tore my eyes from her slightly-blushing face long enough
to check the time on my wristwatch.
dialogues.text:
I tore my eyes from her slightly-blushing face long enough
to check the time on my wristwatch.

dialogues.jp: そろそろ上演時間だ。
dialogues.en: Just about time to head to the theater.
dialogues.text: Just about time to head to the theater.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、そろそろ映画に行くか」
dialogues.en: "We should start going to the movie theater."
dialogues.text: "We should start going to the movie theater."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい！」
dialogues.en: "Okay!"
dialogues.text: "Okay!"

dialogues.jp: 環はとても元気よく返事をする。
dialogues.en: She said in a far more joyful tone that normal.
dialogues.text: She said in a far more joyful tone that normal.

dialogues.jp:
まさか、あれだけのカフェインで、本当に興奮
状態なんじゃないよな？
dialogues.en:
Don't tell me the caffeine is really making her more
excitable...
dialogues.text:
Don't tell me the caffeine is really making her more
excitable...

dialogues.jp: 俺達は喫茶店を出て、映画館に向かう。
dialogues.en:
We left the coffeeshop, towards the direction of the
theater.
dialogues.text:
We left the coffeeshop, towards the direction of the
theater.

dialogues.jp: 「うーん。何見ようか……」
dialogues.en: "Hm. What to watch..."
dialogues.text: "Hm. What to watch..."

dialogues.jp:
やっぱ、デートだし、ラブストーリーかなと思っ
ていたんだけれど、この時間は、同じ時間に上
映する作品がいくつかあるようだ。
dialogues.en:
A romance movie would be expected of a date... but there
aren't really any being shown at this time...
dialogues.text:
A romance movie would be expected of a date... but there
aren't really any being shown at this time...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様、これがいいです！」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama, this one looks good!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama, this one looks good!"

dialogues.jp: 環は、喜々として俺の袖を引っ張る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki excitably pulled on my sleeve.
dialogues.text: Tamaki excitably pulled on my sleeve.

dialogues.jp: 環が指差す方を見ると……。
dialogues.en:
I followed the direction of her pointed finger, to see the
title,
dialogues.text:
I followed the direction of her pointed finger, to see the
title,

dialogues.jp:
『破壊刑事クラッシャー・クロマニヨン人と七
つの海底都市』というタイトルの看板があった。
dialogues.en:
"Destroyer Detective Crusher Cromanion and the 7 Underwater
Cities".
dialogues.text:
"Destroyer Detective Crusher Cromanion and the 7 Underwater
Cities".

dialogues.jp: アクション？　それともＳＦ？
dialogues.en: Is that an action flick? Sci-fi, maybe?
dialogues.text: Is that an action flick? Sci-fi, maybe?

dialogues.jp:
環って、そういうのが趣味だったのか？　なん
か意外だ……。
dialogues.en: Tamaki likes premises like that? Now that's odd...
dialogues.text: Tamaki likes premises like that? Now that's odd...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おもしろそうですよね！」
dialogues.en: "It looks really interesting!"
dialogues.text: "It looks really interesting!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah..."

dialogues.jp: ま、環がいいなら、それでいいけど。
dialogues.en: Well, if Tamaki wants to, it's fine with me.
dialogues.text: Well, if Tamaki wants to, it's fine with me.

dialogues.jp:
環のカフェインは、まだ持続しているらしい。
それとも……。
dialogues.en: I guess her caffeine high is still in effect. And perhaps...
dialogues.text: I guess her caffeine high is still in effect. And perhaps...

dialogues.jp: 俺とのデートに興奮してくれてるのかな？
dialogues.en:
The thought of being on a date with me is having that effect
on her?
dialogues.text:
The thought of being on a date with me is having that effect
on her?

dialogues.jp: そんなことをつい思ってしまう俺だった。
dialogues.en: ...I'm probably the only one who'd even consider that.
dialogues.text: ...I'm probably the only one who'd even consider that.

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺と環の初デートはアクション映画と
いう……すごく印象的なものになった。
dialogues.en:
Not to mention, to be watching an action movie on our first
date... that's... unique.
dialogues.text:
Not to mention, to be watching an action movie on our first
date... that's... unique.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「は〜。ドキドキした」
dialogues.en: "Haaah~, that was thrilling!"
dialogues.text: "Haaah~, that was thrilling!"

dialogues.jp:
環は映画の余韻に浸っているらしく、まだ少し
興奮気味で言う。
dialogues.en:
We left the theater, the reverberations of the credits still
in our ears.
dialogues.text:
We left the theater, the reverberations of the credits still
in our ears.

dialogues.jp:
映画を観終わった俺と環は、公園のベンチで二
人だけの時間を過している。
dialogues.en:
We'd sat down on a bench in a nearby park, to pass some
time.
dialogues.text:
We'd sat down on a bench in a nearby park, to pass some
time.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「特に、ネアンデルタールとクロマニヨンが潜
　水艦で戦うシーンが面白かったです♪」
dialogues.en:
"The submarine fight scene between Neanderthal and Cromanion
was especially cool~"
dialogues.text:
"The submarine fight scene between Neanderthal and Cromanion
was especially cool~"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、そうだね」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, it was."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, it was."

dialogues.jp:
すさまじいばかりのＢ級映画だったが、環はそ
れでも充分に楽しめたようだ。
dialogues.en:
It wasn't really any better than a b-grade movie, but she
was still so happy at watching it.
dialogues.text:
It wasn't really any better than a b-grade movie, but she
was still so happy at watching it.

dialogues.jp: 環の意外な趣味を知ったような気がする。
dialogues.en: Her tastes are quite surprising.
dialogues.text: Her tastes are quite surprising.

dialogues.jp:
俺が思っていたイメージと、実際の環は少し違
うのかも知れない。
dialogues.en:
The choices she makes are rather different from the image
that I had of her in my mind.
dialogues.text:
The choices she makes are rather different from the image
that I had of her in my mind.

dialogues.jp:
でも、こんな風に自然でいてくれるってことは、
俺に心を開いてくれているってことだ。
dialogues.en:
But, being able to act and do as she likes, it's like she's
opening her heart to me.
dialogues.text:
But, being able to act and do as she likes, it's like she's
opening her heart to me.

dialogues.jp: それは、素直にうれしかった。
dialogues.en: I'm glad she's able to display herself so honestly to me.
dialogues.text: I'm glad she's able to display herself so honestly to me.

dialogues.jp: 「よかったら、また行こうぜ」
dialogues.en: "If you want, we could go again sometime."
dialogues.text: "If you want, we could go again sometime."

dialogues.jp: 自然とそんな言葉が口をつく。
dialogues.en: I said that to her spontaneously myself.
dialogues.text: I said that to her spontaneously myself.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Yes, that would be fun."
dialogues.text: "Yes, that would be fun."

dialogues.jp: 環はニッコリと微笑む。
dialogues.en: Her cute, yet beautiful smile.
dialogues.text: Her cute, yet beautiful smile.

dialogues.jp: と、立ち上がると同時に、環は石に躓く。
dialogues.en: Just as she stood up, she tripped over a stone.
dialogues.text: Just as she stood up, she tripped over a stone.

dialogues.jp: その拍子に、前のめりになって転んでしまう。
dialogues.en: She fell onto the floor, rolling a little.
dialogues.text: She fell onto the floor, rolling a little.

dialogues.jp: 環の手に持っていた鞄の中身が散乱する。
dialogues.en:
The bag she was holding spilled it's contents all over the
floor.
dialogues.text:
The bag she was holding spilled it's contents all over the
floor.

dialogues.jp: 「お、おい」
dialogues.en: "H, hey!"
dialogues.text: "H, hey!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は慌てて環の元へ駆けつける。
dialogues.en: I hurried to her side.
dialogues.text: I hurried to her side.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……いたた」

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おい、大丈夫か？」
dialogues.en: "Are you alright?"
dialogues.text: "Are you alright?"

dialogues.jp: 環を立ち上がらせ、泥を払ってやる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki stood up by herself, wiping the mud off her clothes.
dialogues.text: Tamaki stood up by herself, wiping the mud off her clothes.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はあ。わたくしとしたことが……」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I'm fine..."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I'm fine..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「怪我はないか？」
dialogues.en: "No pain anywhere?"
dialogues.text: "No pain anywhere?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。ちょっと擦りむいたくらいで」
dialogues.en: "None, just a scratch."
dialogues.text: "None, just a scratch."

dialogues.jp:
と、袴の｛すそ／裾｝を少し上げる。白くて綺麗な、形の
いい脚に血が｛にじ／滲｝んでいた。
dialogues.en:
She lifted the trousers of her hakama, showing her her
creamy white leg with a patch of blood.
dialogues.text:
She lifted the trousers of her hakama, showing her her
creamy white leg with a patch of blood.

dialogues.jp: 「舐めれば、治るって聞くぜ」
dialogues.en: "I heard licking it would make it get better."
dialogues.text: "I heard licking it would make it get better."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「え？　そ、そんな、悪いですよ。泥ついてま
　すし……そんな……」
dialogues.en: "E, ehhh? T, that can't be true... and it's muddy... and..."
dialogues.text: "E, ehhh? T, that can't be true... and it's muddy... and..."

dialogues.jp: 環は赤面し、明らかに動揺している。
dialogues.en: Tamaki turned red instantly, obviously flustered.
dialogues.text: Tamaki turned red instantly, obviously flustered.

dialogues.jp: ひょっとして、俺が本当に舐めると思ったのか？
dialogues.en: Did she really think I was going to lick it?
dialogues.text: Did she really think I was going to lick it?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ハ、ハンカチで押さえておきますから」
dialogues.en: "A, a handkerchief should be enough to stop the swelling..."
dialogues.text: "A, a handkerchief should be enough to stop the swelling..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah."
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah."

dialogues.jp: 俺達は、お互いに照れ笑いをする。
dialogues.en: We shared similarly embarassed smiles.
dialogues.text: We shared similarly embarassed smiles.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ahhhh!!"
dialogues.text: "Ahhhh!!"

dialogues.jp: 今度は何だよ。
dialogues.en: Now what?
dialogues.text: Now what?

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうした？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What's up?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's up?"

dialogues.jp: 環は急いで自分の鞄に駆け寄り、しゃがみこむ。
dialogues.en: Tamaki hurried over and squatted at the remains of her bag.
dialogues.text: Tamaki hurried over and squatted at the remains of her bag.

dialogues.jp: 散乱した鞄の中身から、水色の袋を手に取る。
dialogues.en: Inside the bag was a smaller, water-blue coloured satchel.
dialogues.text: Inside the bag was a smaller, water-blue coloured satchel.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はあ〜。割れちゃった」
dialogues.en: "Haaah~. It's ruined..."
dialogues.text: "Haaah~. It's ruined..."

dialogues.jp:
環は、その袋を振ったり、指でなぞったりして、
深いため息をつく。
dialogues.en:
She took the smaller satchel, and poked at it, before
releasing a deep sigh.
dialogues.text:
She took the smaller satchel, and poked at it, before
releasing a deep sigh.

dialogues.jp: 「どうした？　何か壊れたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? What's ruined?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? What's ruined?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環の横にしゃがむ。
dialogues.en: I squatted down next to her as well.
dialogues.text: I squatted down next to her as well.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「徹夜して作ったのに……」
dialogues.en: "I spent the whole night making it..."
dialogues.text: "I spent the whole night making it..."

dialogues.jp: 環は悲しそうな顔をして、袋を見つめている。
dialogues.en: Her sad eyes never left the satchel.
dialogues.text: Her sad eyes never left the satchel.

dialogues.jp: 「そんなに大切なものなのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is that so important to you?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so important to you?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「はい……。実は、朝倉様にプレゼントしよう
　と思って」
dialogues.en: "Yes... I had an idea, for a present for you."
dialogues.text: "Yes... I had an idea, for a present for you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「プレゼント？」
dialogues.en: "A present?"
dialogues.text: "A present?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「はい。男の人にプレゼントするのは、チョコ
　レートが一番だと聞いて……」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. I heard that the way to a man's heart, is to feed him
with chocolates..."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. I heard that the way to a man's heart, is to feed him
with chocolates..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「昨日、本を買って作ってみたんです」
dialogues.en: "...So yesterday, I bought a book on how to make chocolate."
dialogues.text: "...So yesterday, I bought a book on how to make chocolate."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わざわざ、俺のために？」
dialogues.en: "All that trouble, for me?"
dialogues.text: "All that trouble, for me?"

dialogues.jp:
昨日の本は、そういうことか。確かにプレゼン
トは少しばかり恥ずかしい。ちょっと感動した
かも。
dialogues.en:
That must've been the book yesterday... a present now is
really embarassing, even if it's really nice.
dialogues.text:
That must've been the book yesterday... a present now is
really embarassing, even if it's really nice.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「確か、バレンタインプレゼントって言うんで
　すよね？」
dialogues.en:
"I believe they called it a Valentine's present, is that
correct?"
dialogues.text:
"I believe they called it a Valentine's present, is that
correct?"

dialogues.jp: ん？　バレンタインプレゼント？
dialogues.en: Eh? Valentine's present?
dialogues.text: Eh? Valentine's present?

dialogues.jp:
「それって、ひょっとして、バレンタインデー
　のこと？」
dialogues.en: "...By any chance, are you talking about Valentine's Day?"
dialogues.text: "...By any chance, are you talking about Valentine's Day?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、名前が少し違うのですね？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, did I get the name wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, did I get the name wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「名前も違うけど……、今は３月だぞ」
dialogues.en: "Not only is the name wrong... it's also March."
dialogues.text: "Not only is the name wrong... it's also March."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「３月じゃ、ダメなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "It can't be done on March?"
dialogues.text: "It can't be done on March?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「バレンタインデーは２月だよ」
dialogues.en: "Valentine's Day is in February."
dialogues.text: "Valentine's Day is in February."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、今はダメなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "...It can't be done now?"
dialogues.text: "...It can't be done now?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いやまぁ、稀にさくらのように、大幅に遅れ
　てチョコを送ってくるやつもいるが」
dialogues.en:
"Well, yeah... Sakura's huge chocolate presents rarely come
till around March, though."
dialogues.text:
"Well, yeah... Sakura's huge chocolate presents rarely come
till around March, though."

dialogues.jp: それにしたって、２月中の話である。
dialogues.en: And there's the whole, it's not February thing...
dialogues.text: And there's the whole, it's not February thing...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうだったんですか……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I see..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I see..."

dialogues.jp: 環は本当に残念そうな声で、肩を落とす。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's shoulders drooped, completely dejected.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's shoulders drooped, completely dejected.

dialogues.jp: 「いや……。ダメって訳じゃないけど……」
dialogues.en: "Um... it's not that it can't EVER be done..."
dialogues.text: "Um... it's not that it can't EVER be done..."

dialogues.jp: 根本的な勘違いだな。
dialogues.en: It's just that she was mistaken from the beginning..
dialogues.text: It's just that she was mistaken from the beginning..

dialogues.jp: でも、素直に環の気持ちは嬉しい。
dialogues.en: To see her honest feelings is great, though.
dialogues.text: To see her honest feelings is great, though.

dialogues.jp: 「それ、もらってもいいかな？」
dialogues.en: "Can I have it?"
dialogues.text: "Can I have it?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「で、でも割れてしまってますし……」
dialogues.en: "B, but it's broken into so many pieces now..."
dialogues.text: "B, but it's broken into so many pieces now..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「せっかく、環が俺のために作ってきてくれた
　んだ。割れてたって、俺は嬉しいよ」
dialogues.en:
"You worked so hard to make it for me. Broken or not, I'm
delighted still."
dialogues.text:
"You worked so hard to make it for me. Broken or not, I'm
delighted still."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……じゃあ」
環は俺に、水色の袋を渡す。
dialogues.en: Tamaki passed the satchel to me.
dialogues.text: Tamaki passed the satchel to me.

dialogues.jp:
中を開くと、チョコはもう原型をとどめておら
ず、粉々になってしまっていた。
dialogues.en:
I opened the box. Just as she said, the chocolate was broken
into several tiny pieces.
dialogues.text:
I opened the box. Just as she said, the chocolate was broken
into several tiny pieces.

dialogues.jp: ま、チョコチップだと思えばいいか。
dialogues.en: Well, I could just think of it as chocolate chips.
dialogues.text: Well, I could just think of it as chocolate chips.

dialogues.jp: 「ありがとな」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、もらったチョコを一口食べる。
dialogues.en: I took a mouthul of the chocolate.
dialogues.text: I took a mouthul of the chocolate.

dialogues.jp: この味。
dialogues.en: This taste...
dialogues.text: This taste...

dialogues.jp: なんか、不思議な味だ。
dialogues.en: It's an... uncommon one.
dialogues.text: It's an... uncommon one.

dialogues.jp: 甘さとしょっぱさが融合している。
dialogues.en: A fusion between sweet and salty.
dialogues.text: A fusion between sweet and salty.

dialogues.jp: 俺は料理はあまり得意ではない。
dialogues.en: I wouldn't call myself some fancy-schmancy gourmet,
dialogues.text: I wouldn't call myself some fancy-schmancy gourmet,

dialogues.jp:
しかし、これはチョコではない、と分かるぐら
いの味覚は持ち合わせているつもりだ。
dialogues.en:
But, even I can tell from this taste, that this isn't really
chocolate.
dialogues.text:
But, even I can tell from this taste, that this isn't really
chocolate.

dialogues.jp:
ザラっとした舌触りを感じたため、歯でゆっく
りと噛んでみる。
dialogues.en: The rough taste still lingered around my teeth.
dialogues.text: The rough taste still lingered around my teeth.

dialogues.jp: この、魚っぽい味は……。
dialogues.en: This fishy taste...
dialogues.text: This fishy taste...

dialogues.jp: 「あ、桜海老……」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, Sakura Lobster..."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, Sakura Lobster..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「すごい。よくお分かりになりましたね。隠し
　味ですよ♪」
dialogues.en:
"Amazing! You discovered it from just one taste. It's the
secret ingredient~"
dialogues.text:
"Amazing! You discovered it from just one taste. It's the
secret ingredient~"

dialogues.jp:
隠し味ねぇ……。そんなの、隠さなくてもよろ
しい。
dialogues.en: Secret ingredient, huh... it should've stayed more secret.
dialogues.text: Secret ingredient, huh... it should've stayed more secret.

dialogues.jp: 多分、他にも何か入っているのだろう。
dialogues.en: And it tastes like there's more than just that inside...
dialogues.text: And it tastes like there's more than just that inside...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おいしいですか？」
dialogues.en: "Is it good?"
dialogues.text: "Is it good?"

dialogues.jp:
環は、少し心配になったのか、上目遣いで尋ね
てくる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki looked slightly upwards at me, with puppy-dog eyes.
dialogues.text: Tamaki looked slightly upwards at me, with puppy-dog eyes.

dialogues.jp:
本人のためを思えば、正直に感想を言うべきだ
ろうが……。
dialogues.en: If I cared about myself, I would answer honestly...
dialogues.text: If I cared about myself, I would answer honestly...

dialogues.jp:
しかし、徹夜してまで作ってくれたものに、ケ
チをつける訳にはいかない。
dialogues.en:
But she spent all night making it... I can't just break it
like that.
dialogues.text:
But she spent all night making it... I can't just break it
like that.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだか、お好み焼きみたいでおいしいよ」
dialogues.en: "It takes fried... which I like... it's nice."
dialogues.text: "It takes fried... which I like... it's nice."

dialogues.jp:
我ながら、褒めてるのかけなしてるのかわから
ない言葉だな。
dialogues.en:
I mumbled out some form of compliments which I didn't even
understand.
dialogues.text:
I mumbled out some form of compliments which I didn't even
understand.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかった」
dialogues.en: "Thank goodness."
dialogues.text: "Thank goodness."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……うん、おいしい」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, it's good."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, it's good."

dialogues.jp:
環はほっと胸を撫で下ろしている。その顔を見
ただけで、良しとしようか。
dialogues.en:
She put a hand to her chest in relief. Seeing that face
convinced me that I did the right thing.
dialogues.text:
She put a hand to her chest in relief. Seeing that face
convinced me that I did the right thing.

dialogues.jp: 結局俺は、チョコレートを全て平らげた。
dialogues.en: In the end, I managed to force down the whole thing.
dialogues.text: In the end, I managed to force down the whole thing.

dialogues.jp:
口の中に、ほのかな甘さと限りないしょっぱさ
を残して……。
dialogues.en: The mixture of tastes wouldn't leave my mouth...
dialogues.text: The mixture of tastes wouldn't leave my mouth...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今日はどうもありがとうございました」
dialogues.en: "Thank you very much for today."
dialogues.text: "Thank you very much for today."

dialogues.jp: 環は、俺に深々と頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki bowed deeply.
dialogues.text: Tamaki bowed deeply.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ。送っていかなくていいのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah... are you sure you don't want me to accompany you
home?"
dialogues.text:
"Yeah... are you sure you don't want me to accompany you
home?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫です。一人で帰れますから……」
dialogues.en: "It is fine, I have troubled you enough..."
dialogues.text: "It is fine, I have troubled you enough..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「今日は、朝倉様が家に入るまで見ていたいん
　です」
dialogues.en:
"I was able to see your home from the inside today, after
all."
dialogues.text:
"I was able to see your home from the inside today, after
all."

dialogues.jp: なんだか照れるな。
dialogues.en: ...That was somehow embarassing.
dialogues.text: ...That was somehow embarassing.

dialogues.jp: もう、別れないといけないのか。
dialogues.en: I guess we've stayed together long enough.
dialogues.text: I guess we've stayed together long enough.

dialogues.jp: 時間が過ぎるのって、意外に早いな。
dialogues.en: Time just seem to fly with her.
dialogues.text: Time just seem to fly with her.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、またな」
dialogues.en: "I'd see you around."
dialogues.text: "I'd see you around."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。おやすみなさい」
dialogues.en: "Yes, good night."
dialogues.text: "Yes, good night."

dialogues.jp: 俺は門に入り、ドアノブに手をかける。
dialogues.en:
I entered the gates, and put my head on the doorknob to
home.
dialogues.text:
I entered the gates, and put my head on the doorknob to
home.

dialogues.jp: ふと振り返ると、環が門の外で手を振っている。
dialogues.en: I turned around, seeing Tamaki at the gates, waving goodbye.
dialogues.text: I turned around, seeing Tamaki at the gates, waving goodbye.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ドアノブから手を離し、門まで戻る。
dialogues.en: I let go of the doorknob, and returned to the gate.
dialogues.text: I let go of the doorknob, and returned to the gate.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　家に入らないんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ah? You aren't going inside?"
dialogues.text: "Ah? You aren't going inside?"

dialogues.jp: 環は不思議そうに俺を見る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki looked at me puzzledly.
dialogues.text: Tamaki looked at me puzzledly.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、門にもたれて環に尋ねる。
dialogues.en: I leant on the gate, and began to ask.
dialogues.text: I leant on the gate, and began to ask.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、あのさ……」
dialogues.en: "Um, Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Um, Tamaki..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい？　何でしょう？」
dialogues.en: "Yes? What is the matter?"
dialogues.text: "Yes? What is the matter?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今度の火曜日、暇？」
dialogues.en: "Are you free this Tuesday?"
dialogues.text: "Are you free this Tuesday?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……はい、一応、暇ですけど」
dialogues.en: "...I am, I have no plans for that day."
dialogues.text: "...I am, I have no plans for that day."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、また一緒に過ごさないか？」
dialogues.en: "Would you like to spend it together?"
dialogues.text: "Would you like to spend it together?"

dialogues.jp:
今回は、俺から誘ってみる。デートは本来、男
から誘うものだからな。
dialogues.en:
It was my turn. It should be the guy inviting the girl to
dates, anyway.
dialogues.text:
It was my turn. It should be the guy inviting the girl to
dates, anyway.

dialogues.jp: かなり、かったるいけど……。
dialogues.en: Although it's a bit troublesome...
dialogues.text: Although it's a bit troublesome...

dialogues.jp: 環は、満面の笑みを浮かべる。
dialogues.en: Her smile though, enveloped her whole face.
dialogues.text: Her smile though, enveloped her whole face.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。喜んで」
dialogues.en: "I would be delighted to."
dialogues.text: "I would be delighted to."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、火曜日な」
dialogues.en: That took a lot of my courage.
dialogues.text: That took a lot of my courage.

dialogues.jp:
俺はそう言うと、環の方は見ずに、急いで家に
入る。
dialogues.en: Just to ask her out on a date...
dialogues.text: Just to ask her out on a date...

dialogues.jp: 結構、勇気いるもんだな。
デートに誘うのって。

dialogues.en: Where am I?
dialogues.text: Where am I?

dialogues.en: I couldn't see anything besides myself.
dialogues.text: I couldn't see anything besides myself.

dialogues.jp: ここは、何処だ？
dialogues.en: In other words, this has to be someone's dream.
dialogues.text: In other words, this has to be someone's dream.

dialogues.jp: 俺の意思で映像が見えない。
dialogues.en: A overjoyed voice followed from my conclusion.
dialogues.text: A overjoyed voice followed from my conclusion.

dialogues.jp: と、言うことは誰かの夢か。
dialogues.en: The voice was getting closer and closer.
dialogues.text: The voice was getting closer and closer.

dialogues.jp: すると、急に笑い声が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en:
In the middle of the brilliant white, I saw Tamaki and I,
walking together hand-in-hand.
dialogues.text:
In the middle of the brilliant white, I saw Tamaki and I,
walking together hand-in-hand.

dialogues.jp: 笑い声はだんだん近づいてくる。
dialogues.en: Ah...
dialogues.text: Ah...

dialogues.jp:
白い闇の向こう側から、環と俺が、手をつない
で歩いてくるのが見えた。
dialogues.en: This must be Tamaki's dream.
dialogues.text: This must be Tamaki's dream.

dialogues.jp: ああ……。
dialogues.en: The full moon hanging in the night sky was stunning.
dialogues.text: The full moon hanging in the night sky was stunning.

dialogues.jp: これ、環の夢か。
dialogues.en: This looks like the back of the shrine.
dialogues.text: This looks like the back of the shrine.

dialogues.jp:
なんか、いい雰囲気だよな。既に、恋人同士と
いうか……。
dialogues.en:
The atompshere was really good... perfect for a pair of
lovers...
dialogues.text:
The atompshere was really good... perfect for a pair of
lovers...

dialogues.jp: お互いが信頼しあっているような……。
dialogues.en: Two people with absolute trust and faith in each other...
dialogues.text: Two people with absolute trust and faith in each other...

dialogues.jp: 見ていて微笑ましい。
dialogues.en: Just looking at the scene gave me a warm, fuzzy feeling.
dialogues.text: Just looking at the scene gave me a warm, fuzzy feeling.

dialogues.jp: ま、片方は俺なんだけど……。
dialogues.en: I suppose it helps that one of those people is me...
dialogues.text: I suppose it helps that one of those people is me...

dialogues.jp: 何、笑ってんだろう？
dialogues.en: What are we laughing about, though?
dialogues.text: What are we laughing about, though?

dialogues.jp: 二人が話している内容まではよく聞こえない。
dialogues.en: I couldn't properly hear what we were talking about.
dialogues.text: I couldn't properly hear what we were talking about.

dialogues.jp:
おそらく、環の意識の中に、具体的な会話の内
容が思い浮かんでないのだろう。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki's subconscious probably wasn't conjuring up any
actual subject for us to talk about.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki's subconscious probably wasn't conjuring up any
actual subject for us to talk about.

dialogues.jp: こういうことは良くある。
dialogues.en: That's good in it's own way.
dialogues.text: That's good in it's own way.

dialogues.jp:
観念的というか、『楽しい』という抽象的な思
いだけで、細かいところは、全く思いつかない
ようなことが……。
dialogues.en:
There's no need to think over so deeply what enjoyment
really means.
dialogues.text:
There's no need to think over so deeply what enjoyment
really means.

dialogues.jp:
それにしても、二人は楽しそうだ。感覚的に楽
しいという気持ちは流れてくる。
dialogues.en:
It's easy enough for me to tell that those two were happy. I
could feel their happiness emnating.
dialogues.text:
It's easy enough for me to tell that those two were happy. I
could feel their happiness emnating.

dialogues.jp: 何か、こっちまで幸せになれる。
dialogues.en: It's odd, for me to be so happy as well.
dialogues.text: It's odd, for me to be so happy as well.

dialogues.jp:
俺が見る他人の夢も、こういうのばかりだと楽
なんだけど……。
dialogues.en: I'm just seeing someone else's sweet dream, after all...
dialogues.text: I'm just seeing someone else's sweet dream, after all...

dialogues.jp: ふと、二人の笑い声とは別の声が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, a seperate voice became audible to my ears.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, a seperate voice became audible to my ears.

dialogues.speaker: Voice
dialogues.jp: 「いいよね」
dialogues.en: "It seems so nice, doesn't it?"
dialogues.text: "It seems so nice, doesn't it?"

dialogues.jp: 誰の声だ？
dialogues.en: Whose voice is that?
dialogues.text: Whose voice is that?

dialogues.speaker: Voice
dialogues.jp:
「夢の中でなら、普通の女の子になったってい
　いよね……」
dialogues.en: "It's so nice to be able to be a normal girl, in dreams..."
dialogues.text: "It's so nice to be able to be a normal girl, in dreams..."

dialogues.jp: どうやら環の意思の声みたいだ。
dialogues.en: Seems like it's Tamaki's subconsciousness.
dialogues.text: Seems like it's Tamaki's subconsciousness.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「好きな人と、一緒にいてもいいよね……」
dialogues.en: "And being with your loved one..."
dialogues.text: "And being with your loved one..."

dialogues.jp: 好きな人って……俺のこと？
dialogues.en: Loved one... she means me?
dialogues.text: Loved one... she means me?

dialogues.jp: ……もちろん、気づいてないわけじゃない。
dialogues.en: ...Of course, I'm not THAT clueless.
dialogues.text: ...Of course, I'm not THAT clueless.

dialogues.jp:
環が、俺のことを好きだろうということは、な
んとなく分かっていた。
dialogues.en:
I knew from the way she was around me, that she liked me
quite a bit.
dialogues.text:
I knew from the way she was around me, that she liked me
quite a bit.

dialogues.jp: ただ、意識はしないようにしていた。
dialogues.en: The seriousness of it just never made an impact on me.
dialogues.text: The seriousness of it just never made an impact on me.

dialogues.jp:
俺だって、自分の気持ちをなるべく意識しない
ようにしてたんだ。
dialogues.en:
And perhaps, I was trying to keep myself away from it as
well.
dialogues.text:
And perhaps, I was trying to keep myself away from it as
well.

dialogues.jp: 自分の中の、環に対する想い。
dialogues.en: Away from having to face my feelings towards Tamaki.
dialogues.text: Away from having to face my feelings towards Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
いつの間にか、友達よりも大切になっていた。
気づいたら、二人の関係が壊れそうで怖かった。
dialogues.en:
At some point, she became more than just a friend to me. I
became afraid of losing my connection with her.
dialogues.text:
At some point, she became more than just a friend to me. I
became afraid of losing my connection with her.

dialogues.jp: だから俺は、自分の気持ちを抑えてた。
dialogues.en: But I had forced myself to keep my feelings inside.
dialogues.text: But I had forced myself to keep my feelings inside.

dialogues.jp: 本当は、もっと早く自覚するべきだったんだな。
dialogues.en: Truthfully, now, I just wanted to wake up already.
dialogues.text: Truthfully, now, I just wanted to wake up already.

dialogues.jp: 改めて言われると、正直、やっぱり嬉しい。
dialogues.en:
I should've just been honest from the start, and I'd be so
happy now.
dialogues.text:
I should've just been honest from the start, and I'd be so
happy now.

dialogues.jp: 環の気持ちに、応えてあげたいと思う。
dialogues.en: Especially since I know her feelings as well.
dialogues.text: Especially since I know her feelings as well.

dialogues.jp:
しかし俺は、次の瞬間、奈落の底へ落ちること
になる。
dialogues.en:
But in the next moment, I was sent plummeting from the
clouds of heaven, to the depths of hell.
dialogues.text:
But in the next moment, I was sent plummeting from the
clouds of heaven, to the depths of hell.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「せめて、今だけ……」
dialogues.en: "But this is best, for now..."
dialogues.text: "But this is best, for now..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうせ、二人は……」
dialogues.en: "After all, our..."
dialogues.text: "After all, our..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「二人は結ばれない未来なんだから……」
dialogues.en: "Our futures... are seperate..."
dialogues.text: "Our futures... are seperate..."

dialogues.jp: え？
dialogues.en: Ehh?
dialogues.text: Ehh?

dialogues.jp: 結ばれない未来？　どういうことだ……？
dialogues.en: Our futures are seperate? What does she mean...?
dialogues.text: Our futures are seperate? What does she mean...?

dialogues.jp: 俺は頭の中をフル回転させて考える。
dialogues.en: My head began to spin at the impact.
dialogues.text: My head began to spin at the impact.

dialogues.jp: 未来……。
dialogues.en: Our futures...
dialogues.text: Our futures...

dialogues.jp: 予知能力？
dialogues.en: Her clairvoyance?
dialogues.text: Her clairvoyance?

dialogues.jp: そんな言葉が、俺の頭をよぎる。
dialogues.en: Those words echoed in my head constantly.
dialogues.text: Those words echoed in my head constantly.

dialogues.jp:
環は以前、俺の未来が見えると言っていた。じゃ
あ、俺達の未来も、見えるってことか？
dialogues.en:
Tamaki told me before that she had seen my future. So she
saw our future as well?
dialogues.text:
Tamaki told me before that she had seen my future. So she
saw our future as well?

dialogues.jp: 『ドウセ　ムスバレナイ　ミライ……』
dialogues.en: "After all, our futures are seperate..."
dialogues.text: "After all, our futures are seperate..."

dialogues.jp: 環は、俺との結ばれない未来を予知した。
dialogues.en: Tamaki foresaw that we were not meant to be together...
dialogues.text: Tamaki foresaw that we were not meant to be together...

dialogues.jp: そして、諦めてしまっている……？
dialogues.en: And just... accepted it...?
dialogues.text: And just... accepted it...?

dialogues.jp: 「環、それはどういうことだ！？」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki, what do you mean by that!?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki, what do you mean by that!?"

dialogues.jp: 問いかけるが、俺の声は届かない。
dialogues.en: I cried out to her, but my voice would not travel anywhere.
dialogues.text: I cried out to her, but my voice would not travel anywhere.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、人の夢を見ることは出来ても、干渉する
ことはできない。
dialogues.en:
I can see other people's dreams, but I don't have the power
to interfere with them.
dialogues.text:
I can see other people's dreams, but I don't have the power
to interfere with them.

dialogues.jp: 環の意思の言葉が、俺の中に入り込む。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's subconscious words struck deep into my soul.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's subconscious words struck deep into my soul.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「淋しい……」
dialogues.en: "It's so lonely..."
dialogues.text: "It's so lonely..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「一緒にいられないのに……」
dialogues.en: "That we can't be together..."
dialogues.text: "That we can't be together..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「好きです、なんて……」
dialogues.en: "I love him... so why..."
dialogues.text: "I love him... so why..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「なんて残酷な言葉……」
dialogues.en: "Why such cruel words..."
dialogues.text: "Why such cruel words..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「きっと……口にしてはいけない言葉……」
dialogues.en: "Those words... that I can't bear to say..."
dialogues.text: "Those words... that I can't bear to say..."

dialogues.en: Tamaki...
dialogues.text: Tamaki...

dialogues.jp: 環と俺は、結ばれないのか？
dialogues.en: Tamaki and I can't be together?
dialogues.text: Tamaki and I can't be together?

dialogues.jp: 二人は、惹かれあっているんじゃないのか？
dialogues.en: Isn't there compatibility between us?
dialogues.text: Isn't there compatibility between us?

dialogues.jp: どうして？
dialogues.en: Why?
dialogues.text: Why?

dialogues.jp:
環はこれを知ってて、俺に『友達でいてくださ
い』って言ったのか？
dialogues.en:
She knew this... is that why she asked me to "be good
friends"?
dialogues.text:
She knew this... is that why she asked me to "be good
friends"?

dialogues.jp: 俺達は、結ばれる運命に無いから……。
dialogues.en: Because our fates were not tied together...
dialogues.text: Because our fates were not tied together...

dialogues.jp: あの時、あの時見た俺の未来は……。
dialogues.en: At that time, that time she saw my future...
dialogues.text: At that time, that time she saw my future...

dialogues.jp:
そんなの、納得がいかない！　お互い好きなの
に、どうして一緒にいられないんだ？
dialogues.en:
I can't accept that! If we both love each other, why can't
we be together?
dialogues.text:
I can't accept that! If we both love each other, why can't
we be together?

dialogues.jp: 不自然だ。俺は、絶対に認めない。
dialogues.en: It's crazy. I won't accept it, ever.
dialogues.text: It's crazy. I won't accept it, ever.

dialogues.jp:
このまま、二人が結ばれないままなんて……。
だから、好きと言えないなんて……。
dialogues.en:
Knowing that we can't be together... so never telling me
that she loved me...
dialogues.text:
Knowing that we can't be together... so never telling me
that she loved me...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、俺の気持ちだけでも、環に伝えなきゃ。
dialogues.en: I have to communicate my own feelings to her, for sure.
dialogues.text: I have to communicate my own feelings to her, for sure.

dialogues.jp:
そう思った瞬間、世界は再び白い闇に溶けてい
く。何もかも、覆い隠すように。
dialogues.en:
Before I could think anymore, whitness enveloped everything
once again, shrouding the dream world.
dialogues.text:
Before I could think anymore, whitness enveloped everything
once again, shrouding the dream world.

dialogues.en: Tamaki...!
dialogues.text: Tamaki...!

dialogues.jp: 環の中の、意識が薄らいでいく。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's consciousness was fading within her dream.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's consciousness was fading within her dream.

dialogues.jp:
もう、目が覚めるみたいだ。どんどん……夢の
中が白くなっていく。
dialogues.en:
Looks like she's going to wake up... the dream keeps getting
whiter and whiter.
dialogues.text:
Looks like she's going to wake up... the dream keeps getting
whiter and whiter.

dialogues.jp:
途切れたフィルムのように、白い背景だけが空
回りしていた。
dialogues.en:
The white scenery kept spinning around me, like a roll of
film.
dialogues.text:
The white scenery kept spinning around me, like a roll of
film.

dialogues.jp: ぷつんと、映像が切れ、現実に戻る。
dialogues.en:
The image eventually faded away, returning me back to
reality.
dialogues.text:
The image eventually faded away, returning me back to
reality.

dialogues.jp:
目を覚ました俺は、果てしない｛けんたいかん／倦怠感｝と｛むな／虚｝しさ
に包み込まれていた……。
dialogues.en:
I opened my eyes, overcome by feelings of sadness and
uneasiness...
dialogues.text:
I opened my eyes, overcome by feelings of sadness and
uneasiness...

dialogues.jp: ◆環とデート◆
dialogues.en: ◆Date with Tamaki?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Date with Tamaki?◆

dialogues.jp:
初めてのデートで、環の私服を見ると、なかな
か可愛い。
dialogues.en:
On our first date, Tamaki naturally wore her Miko outfit.
She really is a throughbred Miko...
dialogues.text:
On our first date, Tamaki naturally wore her Miko outfit.
She really is a throughbred Miko...

dialogues.jp:
俺達は、映画を見ることにするが、時間がある
ので喫茶店に入る。
dialogues.en: We decided on a movie, and killed time at a coffeeshop.
dialogues.text: We decided on a movie, and killed time at a coffeeshop.

dialogues.jp:
環は初めてコーヒーを飲んだらしく、カフェイ
ンで興奮状態になってしまっていた。
dialogues.en:
It was the first time Tamaki had drank coffee, and she ended
up on a caffeine high.
dialogues.text:
It was the first time Tamaki had drank coffee, and she ended
up on a caffeine high.

dialogues.jp:
そのせいか、観る映画もアクション映画になっ
てしまった。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to that, we ended up watching an action flick instead
of the usual romance fodder.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to that, we ended up watching an action flick instead
of the usual romance fodder.

dialogues.jp: 映画を観終わり、俺と環は桜公園へ。
dialogues.en: Once the movie ended, we went to the Sakura Park.
dialogues.text: Once the movie ended, we went to the Sakura Park.

dialogues.jp:
環は、うっかり小石につまづき、転んでしまう。
そのせいで、俺のために徹夜で作ったチョコが
粉々になってしまう。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki tripped on a small stone, and dropped the chocolate
she made for me.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki tripped on a small stone, and dropped the chocolate
she made for me.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、くだけたチョコをもらい、口に入れる。
なんとも不思議な味がした。
dialogues.en:
Despite that, I ended up eating the chocolate. It had a
really strange taste.
dialogues.text:
Despite that, I ended up eating the chocolate. It had a
really strange taste.

dialogues.jp: その夜──。
dialogues.en: That night──?B
dialogues.text: That night──?B

dialogues.jp:
環の夢を見ていると、俺と環が楽しそうに話を
している。
dialogues.en:
I was viewing Tamaki's dream, where she and I were happily
talking.
dialogues.text:
I was viewing Tamaki's dream, where she and I were happily
talking.

dialogues.jp:
まるで恋人同士に見えるが、環は俺との未来を
『結ばれない』ものとして予知していた。
dialogues.en:
We looked like girlfriend and boyfriend, but Tamaki had
foreseen our futures to be seperate.
dialogues.text:
We looked like girlfriend and boyfriend, but Tamaki had
foreseen our futures to be seperate.

dialogues.jp:
二人が惹かれあっているのに、どうして結ばれ
ないのか、俺は納得がいかない。
dialogues.en:
We were attracted to eacah other, but we can't be
together... I couldn't accept that.
dialogues.text:
We were attracted to eacah other, but we can't be
together... I couldn't accept that.

dialogues.jp: 絶対にこの気持ちを伝えたい、と思うのだった。
dialogues.en: I'd definitely communicate these feelings.
dialogues.text: I'd definitely communicate these feelings.
